summary: Short kerb on a bush-lined road stub off Carmody Road; homes 27 m away.
reasons: Bush on this side, homes 27 m off

best_section.where: West side of the Fifth Avenue stub, just south of the Carmody Road junction

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on both sides; nearest home 27 m, others 55 m and further.
drivers.access_and_room: Reachable from Carmody Road via a narrow sealed stub; width beside the lane looks tight and the section is only 8 m, shorter than a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet stub off a through road; Carmody Road traffic passes about 10 m away.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the stub; a Carmody Road sign 6.5 m away sets 2P limits with resident permits excepted, weekdays 7am-6pm.

flags: Resident-permit 2P sign on Carmody Road, weekdays 7am-6pm
Close to the Carmody Road junction, so exposed to passing traffic
Stub may be narrow with trees close to the lane
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the section, mainly from the west and south; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Exact sealed width of the stub
